newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Acer says no comment on IBM order report.
newsitem.headline: Acer says no comment on IBM order report.

text.p: Taiwan's computer giant Acer Inc on Friday declined to comment on a media report that it had received a US$1 billion order from International Business Machines Corp.
The Economic Daily News reported on Friday that Acer had recently gained a big order worth US$1 billion from IBM, agreeing to produce 500,000 notebook computers in 1998 for IBM.
"Acer will not comment on such reports as we have signed non-disclosure agreements," an Acer spokeswoman said.
The paper said Acer plans to turn out one million notebook computers in 1997, up from 600,000 in 1996.
At 0255 GMT, Acer was up T$3 or 3.55 percent to T$87.5 with turnover at the market's sixth highest.
